name: Crop Input Subsidy to the Farmers for Crop Loss Due to Natural Calamities
benefit: - As per the assistance norms fixed by the State Government, keeping in view the natural calamities that occur from time to time
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant must be a farmer.
   1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat.
   1. The applicant must have suffered crop loss due to natural calamity.
